name: tinto-client-itinerary-pdf
description: Building the dated, tour-specific day-by-day itinerary PDF for a tour that's about to sell, being pitched, or already sold — the document the selling client uses to sell the tour and pass on to their own guests. Split out of tinto-guest-communication so it can be installed on its own — e.g. for Peter, who needs this without the rest of Nélia's daily guest-communication scope.
